textVoice.title: Text voice
textVoice.description: Type or dictate what you want to say and a Portuguese voice speaks for you in the call.
textVoice.micOff: Your microphone stays off in the call. It is only used, on this device, when you ask to speak and write.
textVoice.placeholder: Type what you want to say…
textVoice.enterHint: Enter to speak · Shift+Enter for a new line
textVoice.unavailable: Click Prepare voice to download or load the local model.
textVoice.muted: Join a call and unmute to speak. Server restrictions also apply.
textVoice.ready: Type or speak, then click “Speak in call”.
textVoice.privacy: Everything happens on this device. Only the voice audio goes to the call; the text is sent to no one.
textVoice.gpuUnavailable: GPU is unavailable on this device. Select CPU.
textVoice.localError: Could not prepare or generate speech. Try again or select CPU.
textVoice.downloadHint: First use: approximately 95 MB for CPU or 330 MB for GPU. The model stays on this device.
textVoice.unsupported: To prepare speech, use HTTPS or the updated Electron client. Your real microphone remains off in this mode.
textVoice.setupTitle: Let’s get the voices ready (one time only)
textVoice.setupBody: We need to download about {{size}} MB to this device. After that everything works without downloading again.
textVoice.setupError: The voices could not be prepared. Check your connection and free space, then try again.
textVoice.preparing: Getting ready… this can take a moment.
textVoice.listening: Listening… click “Finish” when you are done speaking.
textVoice.processingHelp: Leave it on Automatic. Change it only if the voice fails or is slow.

soundboard.frequentEmpty: Play sounds to see your favorites here.
soundboard.title: Soundboard
soundboard.description: Play a short effect for everyone in your call. Choose sounds from servers you belong to.
soundboard.uploadHint: Source file up to 5 MB; longer than 5 seconds? Trim it to a 5-second clip. Maximum 40 sounds per server.
soundboard.name: Sound name
soundboard.permissionHint: A role with Create soundboard sounds permission is required to add effects.
soundboard.invalidAudio: Choose a valid audio file up to 5 MB.

grid.returnToGridHint: Click to return to grid view

screenPicker.title: Share Your Screen
screenPicker.chooseHint: Your browser will ask which screen, window or tab to share.
screenPicker.chooseHintSystem: Your system will ask which screen or window to share.
screenPicker.audioNeedsRepick: The system audio setting applies once you choose again.
screenPicker.unsupported: This browser can't share your screen.
screenPicker.captureFailed: The capture could not be started.
screenPicker.startFailed: The stream could not be started.
screenPicker.audioCaptureFailed: Could not start the capture with system audio. Turn off system audio if your system does not support it.
screenPicker.subtitle: Pick what to share, tune the quality, then start.
screenPicker.permissionHintMac: macOS blocks screen capture until Backspace has Screen Recording permission. Grant it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, then try again.
screenPicker.audioApplicationHint: Play audio in the application to list it, then select the window to share.

streamSettings.previewHint: Controls the thumbnail shown before watching. Does not change the stream video.
streamSettings.title: Stream Settings
streamSettings.cursorHideUnavailable: This capture source cannot hide the Windows cursor. Start a supported DXGI capture to apply this setting.
streamSettings.chromeEchoNote: Chrome can exclude Backspace audio when the capture type supports it
streamSettings.electronWindowsAudioNote: Windows loopback may capture call audio when restrictOwnAudio is unsupported
streamSettings.electronMacAudioNote: macOS 13+ requires Screen & System Audio Recording permission
streamSettings.electronLinuxAudioNote: Linux requires PulseAudio compatibility; Backspace audio may also be captured

systemAudioNote.excluded: Viewers hear your computer's sound, but not the voice chat or other Backspace audio.
systemAudioNote.excludedMac: Viewers hear your Mac's sound, but not the voice chat or other Backspace audio. macOS asks for Screen & System Audio Recording permission.
systemAudioNote.includedWindows: This Windows version shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. On Windows 11, Backspace's own audio is left out.
systemAudioNote.includedMac: This macOS version shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. On macOS 14.2 and later, Backspace's own audio is left out. macOS asks for Screen & System Audio Recording permission.
systemAudioNote.includedLinux: Linux shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. Needs PulseAudio, or PipeWire with pipewire-pulse.
systemAudioNote.unavailableMac: System audio needs macOS 13 or later.

streamSettings.systemAudioStartFailed: Could not start the stream with system audio. Disable Share system audio if this platform does not support it.
streamSettings.systemAudioAddFailed: Could not add system audio to the stream.
streamSettings.systemAudioLiveUnavailable: System audio can only be added when a stream starts. Restart the stream to include it.
streamSettings.softwareH264Fallback: Hardware H264 encoding is unavailable. Software OpenH264 is in use; VP9 may perform better.

stream.localPreviewPaused: Local preview paused to save resources. Your stream is still live.

streamDiagnostics.publisherBandwidth: Available bandwidth is limiting stream quality
streamDiagnostics.publisherCpu: The streamer's computer cannot encode video fast enough
streamDiagnostics.unknown: The connection is unstable; the affected side could not be determined

voiceDiagnostics.reconnecting: Connection to the voice server was interrupted — reconnecting…

controls.callWindowFailed: Could not open the call window.

controls.openCallWindow: Open call in a separate window

empty.title: No one is in this channel yet.

micDenied.description: You're listening only — others can't hear you.

connectLocked: You don't have permission to connect to this channel

micPrearm.denied: Microphone access denied. You joined as a listener. Tap "Allow microphone" to grant access.
micPrearm.notFound: No microphone detected. You joined as a listener.

micRetry.stillDenied: Microphone access is still denied. Allow it for this site in your browser or device settings.

callWaiting: Waiting for the other person · ends in {{remaining}}

dictation.title: Voice dictation · Brazilian Portuguese
dictation.deleteConfirm: Delete the copy of {{model}} downloaded by Backspace? You will need to download it again to use it. Other models and files will remain untouched.
dictation.hint: On release: transcribe → generate voice → send to call. Your original microphone audio is never transmitted. Maximum 60 seconds.
dictation.shortcut: Keyboard: {{shortcut}}. Configure “Dictate and send voice (hold)” in Settings → Keybinds.
dictation.monitor: Also hear my voice in the call
dictation.missing: Download the selected model before dictating.
dictation.downloadError: Could not download the model. Check your connection and available storage, then try again.
dictation.micError: Could not record. Allow microphone access and check the selected device.
dictation.noSpeech: No speech detected. Try recording again.
dictation.limit: Recording reached 60 seconds and was cancelled. Record a shorter phrase.
dictation.storageError: Could not access local model storage.
dictation.failed: Could not complete dictation. Try CPU or a smaller model. Any recognized text remains in the box.
dictation.secureContext: Dictation needs microphone access over HTTPS, localhost, or the updated Electron client.
dictation.callHint: Join a call and unmute synthesized voice to send automatically. You can still dictate to fill the text box.
dictation.gpuError: GPU unavailable for this model. Use CPU or Automatic.

trimmer.title: Trim sound effect
trimmer.tooLong: {{file}} lasts {{total}}. Choose up to {{max}} to keep.
trimmer.fits: {{file}} lasts {{total}}. You can trim it; up to {{max}} is kept.
trimmer.trimSilenceHint: Frame the audible part and drop silence at the edges
trimmer.help: Drag the handles to resize, drag the middle or click the waveform to move. With a handle focused, use the arrow keys (Shift for larger steps).
